name: Lost Cities

rounds.endCondition: Game ends when the last card is drawn; a match is 3 games, highest total wins

categories.label: Yellow expedition
categories.hint: cardValueSum = total of number cards; cards = all cards in column (incl. wagers); wagers = wager cards (0-3). Score = (sum - 20) x (1 + wagers), +20 if 8+ cards; 0 if column not started.

tiebreakers.description: Not defined in the rules summary; equal totals are a tie.

notes: family: set-collection. Scored per game; play 3 games and add totals (template scores a single game, sum across games manually). Number cards are 2-10; 3 wager cards per colour. Wager multiplier is 2/3/4 for 1/2/3 wagers. The 8-card bonus counts wager cards and ignores multiplier. Rulebook text per UltraBoardGames (board edition) and RulesPal; the 1999 card-game manual PDF was not downloaded; the card game has the same scoring.
